submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the word that opens an explicit two-term scalar comparison: strongest on the exclusive/limiting focus particle after 'not' ('not only / not just / not merely / not simply / not solely X (but also Y)', 2-4 on this pole's scale, the case behind 9 of its 20 top scan examples), and at roughly 0.5-2.5 on the gradable adjective or degree word that a comparative or equative marker scopes over ('as ADJ as', 'as tough a N as', 'twice as ADJ as', 'more/less/equally ADJ than', 'times ADJ-er than', 'as much/well as'). It peaks on that operator or first compared word, decays through the first compared term, and sits at its ~0.1 baseline for bare focus adverbs ('only a game', 'the only option'), bare or merely intensified adjectives ('very/too/so/quite ADJ'), superlatives ('most important', 'biggest'), non-degree comparisons ('similar to', 'same as', 'whereas', 'compared to', 'as' + NP, coordinating 'as well as'), 'at least/at most', and the second comparison term; in code the same slot shows up as the ternary ' ?' (and weakly as ' >').

class Zend_Reflection_Docblock_Tag_Return extends Zend_Reflection_Docblock_Tag
{
    /**
     * @var string
     */
    protected $_type = null;

    /**
     * Constructor
     *
     * @param  string $tagDocblockLine
     * @return \Zend_Reflection_Docblock_Tag_Return
     */
    public function __construct($tagDocblockLine)
    {
        if (!preg_match('#^@(\w+)\s+([^\s]+)(?:\s+(.*))?#', $tagDocblockLine, $matches)) {
            require_once 'Zend/Reflection/Exception.php';
            throw new Zend_Reflection_Exception('Provided docblock line is does not contain a valid tag');
        }

        if ($matches[1] != 'return') {
            require_once 'Zend/Reflection/Exception.php';
            throw new Zend_Reflection_Exception('Provided docblock line is does not contain a valid @return tag');
        }

        $this->_name = 'return';
        $this->_type = $matches[2];
        if (isset($matches[3])) {
            $this->_description = $matches[3];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get return variable type
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function getType()
    {
        return $this->_type;
    }

adversarial_test_results.detail: Bare focus adverb 'just' meaning 'only' in 'just a few hundred dollars', the named baseline role for a claimed token, with no 'not' and no comparison.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Adjectival 'just' meaning fair, a bare adjective in a named baseline class and a change of part of speech from the claimed focus particle.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: If only I had studied a little harder for that exam last spring.
